narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>At five o'clock I will divide three hundred and sixty by five, and get seventy two degrees.
<bookmark mark='twelve'/>The full turn is cut into twelve equal gaps, because the clock has twelve hours.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The five only tells us how many gaps lie between the two hands.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says divide 360 by 5 for five o'clock; the full circle is shown cut into 12 equal gaps, not 5; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Count the hour gaps between the hands, and multiply by the size of one gap.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. What is the angle between the hands at ten o'clock? Count the gaps the short way round.
